visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Equal Columns With flex: 1
visualizerParams.description: Type three columns that share the row equally. flex: 1 tells every item to grow and take the same share of the free space.

checks.label: The columns share the row equally
checks.expr: (() => { var c = document.querySelectorAll('.col'); return c[0].offsetWidth === c[1].offsetWidth && c[1].offsetWidth === c[2].offsetWidth; })()

checks.label: The columns fill the whole row
checks.expr: (() => { var c = document.querySelectorAll('.col'); return Math.abs(c[0].offsetWidth * 3 - el('.row').offsetWidth) <= 2; })()
